purpose: Choose bootstrap/repair versus post-setup readiness listing from observed installed state instead of assuming the reusable fleet launcher exists.

steps.name: observe installed state
steps.rule: Do not invoke the post-setup launcher before these checks are classified.

steps.name: bootstrap or repair when required
steps.action: Run repository-owned Setup-AgentSwitchboard.cmd or Setup-AgentSwitchboard.ps1 from a safe exact repository state. Reuse healthy components. Preserve setup-summary.json and setup-transcript.txt.
forbidden: manually copy agent-switchboard.cmd as a substitute for setup

steps.name: list readiness
steps.action: Invoke installed agent-switchboard.cmd -ListAgents or repository startup report.

steps.name: route next action
rules: verification-required -> preserve launch-time provider/model probe requirement
BLOCKED/not-configured/unknown -> follow recorded setup/readiness guidance; do not launch work

proofCeiling: Proves deterministic state classification and the required next workflow. Runtime bootstrap success requires observed setup artifacts; agent/provider success remains unproved.
